# How to Connect Shopify to Frontdesk

This guide walks you through connecting your Shopify store to Frontdesk so your AI receptionist can look up orders, check product availability, and answer customer questions about your store — all in real time.

No coding experience needed. Just follow the steps below.

---

## What You'll Need

- A Shopify store (any plan)
- A Frontdesk account
- About 10 minutes

---

## Step 1: Log into your Shopify admin

Go to your Shopify store's admin panel. The URL looks like:

```
https://admin.shopify.com/store/YOUR-STORE-NAME
```

You can also get there by going to shopify.com and clicking "Log in" in the top right.

---

## Step 2: Go to Settings

Once you're logged in, click **Settings** in the bottom-left corner of your Shopify admin.

---

## Step 3: Enable custom app development

1. In Settings, click **Apps and sales channels** in the left sidebar
2. Click **Develop apps** at the top of the page
3. If you see a message saying "Allow custom app development", click it and confirm
4. This is safe — it just lets you create private connections between Shopify and other tools like Frontdesk

---

## Step 4: Create a new app

1. Click **Create an app** in the top right
2. Give it a name like **"Frontdesk AI"**
3. Click **Create app**

---

## Step 5: Set up the permissions (scopes)

This tells Shopify exactly what information Frontdesk is allowed to read. We only need read access — Frontdesk will never change anything in your store.

1. Click the **Configuration** tab
2. Under **Admin API integration**, click **Configure**
3. Check the following permissions (all "read" only):

**Admin API scopes to enable:**

| Category            | Permission to check       |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- |
| All orders          | `read_all_orders`         |
| Online Store Pages  | `read_online_store_pages` |
| Orders              | `read_orders`             |
| Product feeds       | `read_product_feeds`      |
| Product information | `read_product_listings`   |
| Products            | `read_products`           |
| Returns             | `read_returns`            |
| Shipping rates      | `read_shipping`           |

**Customer Account API scopes to enable:**

| Category   | Permission to check        |
| ---------- | --------------------------- |
| Customer   | `customer_read_customers`  |
| Orders     | `customer_read_orders`     |
| Quick Sale | `customer_read_quick_sale` |

4. Click **Save** at the top right

chunks.article_title: How to Connect Shopify to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
> **Important:** Only check the "read" permissions listed above. Do NOT check any "write" permissions. Frontdesk only needs to look up information — it will never modify your store.

---

## Step 6: Install the app

1. Go back to the **Overview** tab of your app
2. Click **Install app** in the top right
3. Click **Install** to confirm

---

## Step 7: Get your credentials

After installing, you'll see your API credentials:

1. Click the **API credentials** tab
2. You'll see three things:
  - **Admin API access token** — Click "Reveal token once" and copy it. **Save this somewhere safe — you can only see it once!**
  - **API key** — Copy this
  - **API secret key** — Copy this

You'll need the **Admin API access token** and your **store URL** for the next step.

Your store URL is your Shopify domain, which looks like: `your-store-name.myshopify.com`

---

## Step 8: Connect to Frontdesk

You have two ways to do this:

### Option A: Tell your AI agent (easiest)

1. Go to app.myaifrontdesk.com and log in
2. Click **Ask Frontdesk** in the left sidebar to open the AI chat
3. Type something like:

> "I want to set up a Shopify integration. My store URL is my-store.myshopify.com and my access token is shpat_xxxxx"

Your AI agent will configure everything for you automatically.

### Option B: Set it up manually

1. Go to app.myaifrontdesk.com and log in
2. Click **Receptionist** in the left sidebar
3. Scroll down to **Developer Automations**
4. Click **API Integration**
5. Click **Add Workflow** and fill in the following:

**For looking up orders:**

| Field          | What to enter                                                                       |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Request URL    | `https://YOUR-STORE.myshopify.com/admin/api/2024-01/orders.json?status=any&limit=5` |
| Request Method | **GET**                                                                             |
| Header Name    | `X-Shopify-Access-Token`                                                            |
| Header Value   | Your Admin API access token (the one starting with `shpat_`)                        |

**For looking up products:**

| Field          | What to enter                                                               |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Request URL    | `https://YOUR-STORE.myshopify.com/admin/api/2024-01/products.json?limit=10` |
| Request Method | **GET**                                                                     |
| Header Name    | `X-Shopify-Access-Token`                                                    |
| Header Value   | Your Admin API access token                                                 |

Replace `YOUR-STORE` with your actual Shopify store name (the part before `.myshopify.com`).

You can also add variables under **Required Information from Customer** to let callers search by specific details. For example:

chunks.article_title: How to Connect Shopify to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
| Variable Name | Type | Question to Ask            |
| ------------- | ---- | --------------------------- |
| order_number  | Text | What is your order number? |

Then use it in the URL: `https://YOUR-STORE.myshopify.com/admin/api/2024-01/orders.json?name={{order_number}}`

---

## What Frontdesk Can Do With Shopify

Once connected, your AI receptionist can:

- **Look up orders** — "Where is my order?" or "What's the status of order #1234?"
- **Check products** — "Do you have the red hoodie in stock?" or "How much does the starter kit cost?"
- **Answer shipping questions** — "How long does shipping take?" or "Do you ship internationally?"
- **Check returns** — "I want to return my order" or "What's your return policy?"

---

## Troubleshooting

**"Invalid API key or access token" error**

- Make sure you're using the **Admin API access token** (starts with `shpat_`), not the API key or secret
- Make sure the app is installed (Step 6)

**"Not found" error**

- Double check your store URL — it should be `your-store-name.myshopify.com`
- Make sure you're using `admin/api/2024-01/` in the URL path

**Can't see the "Develop apps" option**

- You need to be the store owner or have staff permissions that allow app development
- Go to Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps and enable custom app development first

---

## Need Help?

If you get stuck, just open the chat on app.myaifrontdesk.com and say "I need help setting up my Shopify integration" — our team will walk you through it.

chunks.article_title: How to Connect AppFolio to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
# How to Connect AppFolio to Frontdesk

This guide walks you through connecting your AppFolio account to Frontdesk so your AI receptionist can answer caller questions about available rentals, unit details, and property information using live data from your portfolio.

No coding required. Setup takes about a minute once you have your API credentials.

---

## What You'll Need

- An AppFolio account with API access enabled. Available on **AppFolio Plus**, **AppFolio Plus + Database API add-on**, or **Property Manager Max**.
  * **AppFolio Plus alone** gives you read access, which is enough for the integration's three default workflows (Available Units, Unit Details, Property Details, all read operations).
  * If you want the AI to also **create or update** entities in AppFolio (open work orders during a call, add notes to a unit, update tenant information, and similar mutations), you'll need write API access. That comes with **Plus + Database API add-on** or **Property Manager Max**.
- Admin access to your AppFolio instance so you can generate API credentials.
- A Frontdesk account.
- About 5 minutes.

> **Note:** The three default workflows work on any AppFolio plan with API access, including Plus alone. **Write operations** (creating work orders, updating tenant data, etc.) need the Database API tier (Plus + add-on, or Max). Work-order writes additionally need a one-time AppFolio admin approval. See the "Work Orders" section at the end of this guide.

---

## What This Integration Enables

Once connected, three workflows are automatically installed on your receptionist:

- **[AppFolio] Available Units**: real-time list of vacant, rent-ready units. The AI uses it to answer "what's available?" calls.
- **[AppFolio] Unit Details**: amenities, appliances, square footage, deposits, application fees, and the marketing description for a specific unit.
- **[AppFolio] Property Details**: manager, owner, and location details for any property in your portfolio.

The AI calls these workflows live during conversations, so your callers always hear current information.

---

## Step 1: Open the Integrations panel

1. Log into app.myaifrontdesk.com.
2. Click **Receptionist** in the left sidebar.
3. Scroll to the **Integrations** section and expand it.
4. Click the **AppFolio** card.

---

## Step 2: Review what gets enabled

A side panel opens showing the capabilities your AI receptionist will gain once connected, along with the AppFolio plan tier required.

Take a moment to confirm:

chunks.article_title: How to Connect AppFolio to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
- Your AppFolio plan meets the requirement (Property Manager Max, or Plus + Database API add-on).
- The three capabilities listed match what you want your receptionist to handle.

When ready, click **Connect AppFolio**.

---

## Step 3: Generate your AppFolio API credentials

Before you can connect, you need a **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from AppFolio. Generate them from your AppFolio admin in under a minute.

> **Heads up:** You'll need admin access to your AppFolio instance. If you don't see the menu items below, ask your AppFolio admin to do this part.

### 3a. Open General Settings

In a new tab, log into your AppFolio Property Manager. Click your **profile name** in the top-right corner of the navbar, then choose **General Settings** from the dropdown.

### 3b. Open Manage API Settings

On the **General Settings** page, find and click **Manage API Settings** in the first column of links.

### 3c. Generate new credentials

On the **API Settings** page, you'll see the **Reports API** section. Click **Generate New Credentials** to create your Client ID and Client Secret.

If you already have credentials shown here, you can reuse them. Otherwise, click the button to generate a fresh pair.

Copy both the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** somewhere safe. You'll paste them into Frontdesk in the next step.

> **Don't see Manage API Settings?** Your AppFolio plan likely doesn't include the Database API. You need **Property Manager Max**, or **AppFolio Plus** with the **Database API add-on**. Contact your AppFolio account manager to enable it.

---

## Step 4: Paste your credentials into Frontdesk

Back in the Frontdesk **Connect to AppFolio** dialog, fill in all three fields:

| Field             | What to enter                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Subdomain**     | Your AppFolio subdomain (everything before `.appfolio.com`). For example, if your AppFolio URL is `https://acmeproperties.appfolio.com`, enter `acmeproperties`. |
| **Client ID**     | The Client ID you copied in Step 3c.                                                                                                                             |
| **Client Secret** | The Client Secret you copied in Step 3c. Frontdesk stores this encrypted.                                                                                        |

Click **Connect** when all three fields are filled.

---

## Step 5: You're connected

When the connection succeeds, the panel updates to show:

- A green **Connected** badge.
- The subdomain you connected to (e.g. `acmeproperties.appfolio.com`).
- Three workflow toggles, all switched **On** by default.

chunks.article_title: How to Connect AppFolio to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
You can toggle individual workflows off if you want to disable a specific capability. Most customers leave all three on.

That's it. The next call your receptionist takes will use live AppFolio data.

---

## What Frontdesk Can Do With AppFolio

Once connected, your AI receptionist can answer questions like:

- **"What one-bedrooms do you have available under $1,000?"** Pulls vacant, rent-ready units from AppFolio in real time.
- **"What's the deposit on the place on Stoepel Street?"** Looks up unit details (deposit, application fee, square footage, amenities).
- **"Who manages the building on Glenfield?"** Pulls property details (manager, owner, location).
- **"Is the unit pet-friendly?"** Reads amenity and policy data straight from the unit record.

The AI speaks naturally on the phone. It will not read addresses or ZIP codes verbatim, it groups options two-at-a-time so callers do not get overwhelmed, and it offers to text follow-up details when relevant.

---

## Work Orders (Optional)

The three default workflows ship out of the box on any plan with API access. Work orders are a separate capability with two layers of gating on top:

- **Reading work orders** (looking up existing work orders, checking status, telling callers what's already scheduled) works on any plan with API access, including **Plus alone**. No extra approval needed.
- **Writing work orders** (creating new work orders during a call, or updating existing ones) needs both:
  1. **Write API access**, which comes with **Plus + Database API add-on** or **Property Manager Max**, and
  2. A separate **write-access approval from AppFolio** for work orders specifically. From the AppFolio integration panel in Frontdesk, click **Request work-order API access** to open a pre-written email template you can send to AppFolio support.

Once both are in place, the AI can open a work order live on the call when a tenant reports a maintenance issue.

---

## Disconnecting

If you ever need to disconnect:

1. Go to **Receptionist → Integrations → AppFolio**.
2. Scroll to the bottom of the panel.
3. Click **Disconnect**.

This removes the three workflows from your receptionist and revokes Frontdesk's access to your AppFolio data. You can reconnect at any time using the same flow.

---

## Troubleshooting

**"Invalid credentials" error when connecting**

chunks.article_title: How to Connect AppFolio to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
- Double check the subdomain. It should be just the prefix, not the full URL (use `acmeproperties`, not `https://acmeproperties.appfolio.com`).
- Confirm the Client ID and Client Secret were copied without extra spaces.
- Make sure your AppFolio plan includes the Database API.

**"No units returned" during a test call**

- Confirm you have at least one unit in AppFolio with `unit_status` set to `Vacant-Unrented` and `rent_ready` set to `Yes`. Other units are filtered out by design so callers only hear options they can actually rent.

**Workflows are off after connecting**

- Open the AppFolio panel and toggle them on. All three default to on, but they can be manually disabled.

---

## Need Help?

If you get stuck, open the chat on app.myaifrontdesk.com and say "I need help setting up my AppFolio integration." Our team will walk you through it.

chunks.article_title: How to Connect HubSpot to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
# How to Connect HubSpot to Frontdesk

This guide walks you through connecting your HubSpot account to Frontdesk so your contacts stay in sync both ways. Contacts your AI receptionist captures land in HubSpot automatically, and contact updates you make in HubSpot flow back into Frontdesk.

No coding required, and no API keys. You connect securely with OAuth, and setup takes about five minutes.

---

## What You'll Need

- A HubSpot account where you can install apps. You need to be a **Super Admin**, or a user with the App Marketplace install permission.
- A Frontdesk account with **CRM Connections** enabled.
- About 5 minutes.

---

## What This Integration Enables

Once connected, Frontdesk and HubSpot keep your contacts aligned automatically:

- **Contacts flow both ways.** New callers and leads your receptionist captures become HubSpot contacts, and contact changes in HubSpot flow back into Frontdesk.
- **Fields stay mapped.** Name, email, and phone always sync. Frontdesk's AI proposes a mapping for your custom fields, which you review and approve.
- **You choose the speed.** Scheduled sync reconciles changes every 15 minutes. Real-time sync pushes changes within seconds.
- **Nothing is overwritten blindly.** Field-level conflict handling means each side only updates what actually changed.

---

## Step 1: Open the Connections tab

1. Log into app.myaifrontdesk.com.
2. Open **CRM (Customers)** in the left sidebar.
3. Click **Connections** in the tab row.

---

## Step 2: Connect HubSpot

On the HubSpot card, click **Connect HubSpot**. You are redirected to HubSpot to authorize the connection with OAuth 2.0. Sign in to the HubSpot account you want to connect and approve the requested contact permissions. Frontdesk never stores your HubSpot password.

After you authorize, Frontdesk's AI reads the fields in both systems and builds a proposed mapping. If you leave partway through setup, return to the Connections tab and click **Continue setup** on the HubSpot card.

---

## Step 3: Review the AI-suggested field mapping

The **Review field mapping** screen shows every proposed mapping, marked **AI-suggested**. No changes are made in either system until you approve. Mappings are grouped so you can see exactly what will happen:

chunks.article_title: How to Connect HubSpot to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
- **Will sync**: fields matched in both systems. These sync automatically.
- **Core fields**: name, email, and phone. Always synced and cannot be unmapped.
- **Needs your input**: low-confidence matches. Confirm, edit, or choose **Don't sync** for each one, or click **Approve all** to accept the section together.
- **New from HubSpot**: fields that exist only in HubSpot. Frontdesk starts tracking these.
- **New from Frontdesk**: fields that exist only in Frontdesk. HubSpot starts receiving these.
- **Won't sync**: internal fields left out of the sync.

Once every row under **Needs your input** is resolved, click **Approve** and confirm **Approve all mappings**. Syncing does not start until you approve.

---

## Step 4: You're connected

When the mapping is approved, your first sync starts automatically. The connection overview shows the connected portal, when it last synced, and how many contacts are in sync.

From the overview you also choose your **sync speed**:

- **Scheduled (default):** Frontdesk and HubSpot sync changes every 15 minutes.
- **Real-time:** changes sync within seconds, both ways, over webhooks.

You can switch modes at any time, and the change takes effect immediately.

---

## Permissions Frontdesk Requests

During connection you approve these HubSpot permissions:

| Permission                         | Why it is needed                                      |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Read and write contacts            | Sync contacts in both directions.                     |
| Read and manage contact properties | Map fields and create custom properties where needed. |

---

## What Frontdesk Can Do With HubSpot

Once connected, your contacts stay current without any manual data entry:

- **A caller leaves their details.** The AI receptionist captures the lead, and a new contact appears in HubSpot within seconds on Real-time sync.
- **You add a custom field.** Re-run the AI proposal, approve the new mapping, and that field syncs from then on.
- **Both sides edit the same contact.** Field-level handling keeps each change on the field it belongs to, so good data is not lost.

---

## Disconnecting

If you ever need to disconnect:

1. Open the **Connections** tab and select the HubSpot provider.
2. Click **Disconnect** in the provider header and confirm.

Contacts in both systems are preserved, and no contacts are deleted. You can reconnect later, and your approved mapping can be set up again.

---

## Troubleshooting

**The connection shows Disconnected**

- Reconnect from the Connections tab. Your HubSpot authorization may have expired.

chunks.article_title: How to Connect HubSpot to Frontdesk
chunks.text:
**A contact is not appearing**

- On Scheduled sync, allow up to 15 minutes. Confirm the contact has an email or phone value.

**Syncing has not started**

- Syncing does not begin until you approve the field mapping. Open the HubSpot connection and finish approving any rows under **Needs your input**.

**Duplicate contacts**

- Sync matches on email and phone. Make sure test records use consistent values.

---

## Need Help?

If you get stuck, open the chat on app.myaifrontdesk.com and say "I need help setting up my HubSpot integration." Our team will walk you through it.

# GoHighLevel Integration

Connect your GoHighLevel account to Frontdesk so your AI receptionist can book appointments directly on a GoHighLevel calendar. The connection uses OAuth, so you sign in to GoHighLevel once and never have to copy an API key.

## Prerequisites

- A Frontdesk AI account with an active receptionist
- A GoHighLevel account with at least one calendar set up

## Connecting GoHighLevel

1. Open your receptionist dashboard and click **App Integrations** in the sidebar.
2. Find the **Gohighlevel** card. You can use the search bar or browse the category tabs.
3. Click **Integrate Now**. The "Integrate with Gohighlevel" panel opens with three steps: **Connect**, **Calendar**, and **Complete**.
4. On the **Connect** step, click **Connect to Gohighlevel**. A popup window opens where you sign in to GoHighLevel and authorize Frontdesk.
5. After you approve access, the popup closes and the panel shows **Successfully Connected!**
6. Click **Next** to move to the calendar step.

## Selecting a calendar

On the **Select GoHighLevel Calendar** step, Frontdesk loads the calendars from your GoHighLevel account:

1. Open the **Select Calendar** dropdown and choose the calendar you want appointments booked on.
2. Click **Next**. The **Complete** step confirms the integration.
3. Click **Activate Integration**.

Frontdesk creates an appointment booking workflow tied to that calendar. From then on, whenever a caller wants to book or schedule an appointment, your AI receptionist collects the details and books the event on your GoHighLevel calendar. The caller also receives an SMS confirmation.

## Managing the connection

Once connected, the Gohighlevel card in App Integrations shows a green **Connected** badge with two buttons:

- **Disconnect** removes the GoHighLevel connection.
- **Check connection** reopens the integration panel so you can verify the connection or change the selected calendar.

## Connecting through Scheduling

GoHighLevel is also available as a calendar provider in the Scheduling setup. If you prefer, you can connect it there instead of through App Integrations. Both paths create the same appointment booking workflow.

## Troubleshooting

- **Popup was blocked** -- if you see a "Popup was blocked" warning, allow popups for the Frontdesk dashboard in your browser and click **Connect to Gohighlevel** again.
- **No calendars found** -- if the calendar step shows "No calendars found in your GoHighLevel account," create a calendar in GoHighLevel first, then click **Retry**.
- **Connection check failed** -- if the dashboard cannot verify your connection status, refresh the page. If the problem persists, disconnect and reconnect.
- **Please connect to GoHighLevel first** -- you cannot advance past the Connect step until the OAuth flow finishes. Complete the sign-in in the popup window before clicking **Next**.

## Need help?

If you get stuck, open the chat on app.myaifrontdesk.com and say "I need help setting up my GoHighLevel integration."

# Housecall Pro Integration

Connect Housecall Pro to Frontdesk so your AI receptionist can work with your Housecall Pro account during calls, including booking and managing appointments. The integration uses your Housecall Pro API key and takes a few minutes to set up.

## Prerequisites

- A Frontdesk AI account with an active receptionist
- A Housecall Pro account on a plan that includes API access
- Your Housecall Pro API key (found in your Housecall Pro account settings)

## Connecting through App Integrations

1. Open your receptionist dashboard and click **App Integrations** in the sidebar.
2. Find the **HousecallPro** card. You can use the search bar or browse the category tabs.
3. Click **Integrate Now**. The "Integrate with HousecallPro" panel opens with three steps: **API Key**, **Features**, and **Review**.

### Step 1: Connect your account

Enter your Housecall Pro API key in the **Enter your API key** field. If an instructions link is shown, click "Need help finding your API key?" for a walkthrough. Click **Next**.

### Step 2: Select features

Check the features you want to enable. Each feature corresponds to one or more API workflows that your receptionist can trigger during a call.

If any selected feature involves appointment end times, an **Appointment Duration** dropdown appears at the top. Choose how long your appointments usually run (from 30 minutes up to 5 hours). The AI will not ask callers for an end time; it adds this duration to the start time automatically.

Click **Next** when you have selected at least one feature.

### Step 3: Review and activate

The review screen shows the integration name, a masked version of your API key, and the features you selected. Click **Activate Integration**. Frontdesk creates the API workflows and shows "HousecallPro integration is now live!" when it finishes.

## Connecting through Scheduling

Housecall Pro is also available as a calendar provider in the Scheduling setup. There, you enter the same API key, pick the features you want, and set the appointment duration. Both paths create the same workflows, so use whichever is more convenient.

## What your receptionist can do

Once activated, the workflows you selected run automatically whenever a caller's request matches. You can view, edit, or disable each workflow from the **API Workflows** section of your dashboard, just like any other API workflow.

## Troubleshooting

- **"Please enter an API key"** -- the API key field cannot be empty. Paste the full key from Housecall Pro.
- **"Please select at least one feature"** -- you must check at least one feature on step 2 before activating.
- **Failed to fetch event types / check your API key** -- the key is invalid or lacks API access. Generate a fresh key in Housecall Pro and try again.
- **Appointments created with the wrong length** -- edit the integration and adjust the **Appointment Duration** value, or update the end time description in the workflow under API Workflows.

## Need help?

If you get stuck, open the chat on app.myaifrontdesk.com and say "I need help setting up my Housecall Pro integration."

# General Settings

The General Settings page lets you manage account-level preferences that apply across your Frontdesk AI experience.

## Accessing General Settings

1. Open your receptionist dashboard.
2. Navigate to the **General Settings** page from the sidebar.

The page header reads **General Settings** with the subtitle "Manage your general settings."

## Time Zone

The main setting on this page is your **Time Zone**.

### Why it matters

Your time zone controls how all dates and times are displayed across the application, including:

- Call log timestamps
- Appointment scheduling
- Notification delivery times
- Scheduled activities and reports

### Setting your time zone

1. On the General Settings page, find the **Time Zone Settings** card.
2. Use the time zone selector to pick your preferred time zone.
3. Your selection is saved automatically.

A note at the bottom of the card reminds you: "Your current time zone will be used for all notifications and scheduled activities."

## Account-level settings

Additional account settings are available under **Settings** in the User Dashboard sidebar. The Settings page is organized into tabs:

- **Account Settings** -- update your account profile information
- **Manage Password** -- change your login password
- **Timezone** -- set your global time zone preference (when the global timezone feature is enabled)
- **Manage Subscription** -- view and manage your subscription plan (see Plans & Pricing)
- **Manage Usage** -- view promotional credits and coupon codes
- **Manage Credits** -- view credit balances and configure auto-reload (see Credits & Usage)

To access these, click **Settings** in the User Dashboard sidebar.

# Team Management

Add team members to your Frontdesk dashboard and control what each person can see and do. Team management lets you invite colleagues, assign roles, and set granular permissions.

## Video walkthrough

https://www.youtube.com/embed/N9qwLD8Kv5E

## Prerequisites

- An active Frontdesk AI subscription (team management is a paid feature)
- Owner-level access to your account

## Accessing Team Management

1. Open the User Dashboard.
2. Navigate to **Manage Team** from the sidebar or settings.

A banner at the top of the page reads: "Add your whole team to the dashboard and control exactly what each employee can see and do."

## Tabs

The Manage Team page has three tabs:

### All Members

The **All Members** tab shows a table of everyone currently on your team, including their name, email, role, and status. From here you can:

- View member details
- Change a member's role
- Remove a member from the team

### Pending Invitations

The **Pending Invitations** tab shows all invitations that have been sent but not yet accepted. The count appears in the tab label (e.g., "Pending Invitations (3)"). You can:

- View pending invitation details
- Resend or cancel an invitation

### Custom Roles

The **Custom Roles** tab lists any roles you have created beyond the built-in defaults. The count appears in the tab label. You can:

- View custom role details and permissions
- Create new custom roles
- Edit or delete existing custom roles

## Inviting a team member

1. Click the invite button on the Members tab.
2. In the **Invite Member** modal, fill in:
  - **Email** -- the email address of the person you want to invite
  - **Role** -- select from **Default Roles** (such as Viewer or other built-in roles) or any **Custom Roles** you have created
3. Click to send the invitation.

The invited person will receive an email with instructions to join your dashboard.

### Seat limits

Your plan determines how many team members with edit access you can have. If you reach the limit, you can still invite members with the **Viewer** role, which provides read-only access. To add more edit-access seats, upgrade your plan.

## Roles and permissions

### Default roles

Frontdesk includes built-in roles that cover common access levels, including a **Viewer** role for read-only access.

### Custom roles

If the default roles do not fit your needs, create a custom role:

1. Go to the **Custom Roles** tab.
2. Click to create a new custom role.
3. Name the role and configure its permissions.
4. Save the role.

You can then assign the custom role to any team member or new invitation.

## Troubleshooting

## Troubleshooting

- **Number not provisioned** -- make sure you have completed all onboarding steps, including selecting a number and any required document verification.

# Google Voice Integration

Forward calls from your Google Voice number to your AI receptionist so every incoming call is answered automatically.

## Prerequisites

1. **Build and test your AI receptionist** — if you haven't already, this should take about five minutes.
2. **Get a standalone number** from Frontdesk — this should take about one minute. You can do this from the **Phone Number** page in your dashboard.

## Linking Your Number

> **Important:** When following these steps, do **not** try to verify by text or you will have to start the process over. You **must** click "verify by phone" — the small text link below the phone number input field.

1. Open the **Google Voice** app on your phone.
2. Navigate to **Settings**.
3. Under **Account**, select **Devices and Numbers**.
4. Under **Linked Numbers**, select **New Linked Number**.
5. Enter your Frontdesk standalone number in the text box.
6. Click **"verify by phone"** (not the text verification option).

## Finding the Verification Code

Google Voice will call your Frontdesk number and leave a verification code. To find it:

1. Log in to your Frontdesk dashboard.
2. Go to **Logs** > **Call Logs**.
3. Click **Refresh** to load the latest calls.
4. Look for a recent transcribed call containing a six-digit verification code.

> **Tip:** The AI transcription may interpret some digits as words (e.g., "four" instead of "4"). Read the transcript carefully and convert any spoken numbers back to digits.

5. Enter the six-digit code into your Google Voice app to complete the linking.

## Final Setup

After linking, complete these steps so your receptionist answers every call:

1. Open the **Google Voice** app.
2. Navigate to **Settings**.
3. Under **Calls**, toggle **Call Screening** to **off**.
4. Call your Google Voice number to verify that your AI receptionist answers.

Your Google Voice number is now connected. All incoming calls will be forwarded to your AI receptionist automatically.

# Credits & Usage

Frontdesk AI uses a credit-based system to track usage across voice calls, text messages, webform submissions, chatbot conversations, and more. This guide explains how credits work, how to check your balance, and how to buy more.

## Prerequisites

- An active Frontdesk AI subscription (inbound or outbound)

## Accessing credit management

1. Open the User Dashboard.
2. Click **Settings** in the sidebar.
3. Go to the **Manage Credits** tab.

This tab is only visible if you have an active subscription.

## Understanding credits

Your account has two types of credits:

- **Free Credits** -- included with your subscription plan. These reset on a regular cycle (the reset date is shown in the dashboard).
- **Purchased Credits** -- bought separately and added to your balance. These never expire.

The credits page shows your **Purchased credits** balance, along with a card for each feature allocation included in your plan.

## Feature entitlements

Your plan may include dedicated allocations for specific features:

- **Voice Calls** -- credits used per call
- **Text Messages** -- credits used per SMS sent or received
- **Webform Submissions** -- credits used per form submission
- **Chatbot Conversations** -- credits used per chatbot interaction
- **Extra Credits (any feature)** -- bonus credits that can be used for any feature

Each feature shows a progress bar with usage information (e.g., "12 of 100 used") and a status indicator:

- **Green ("X left")** -- you have credits remaining
- **Amber ("Running low")** -- 80% or more of the allocation has been used
- **Red ("Used up")** -- the allocation is exhausted

When a specific feature allocation runs out, your **Extra Credits** are used automatically as a fallback.

The feature entitlements reset along with your free credits on the displayed reset date.

## Buying more credits

1. On the Manage Credits page, click the **Buy Credits** button.
2. In the modal that appears, enter the number of credits you want to purchase.
3. Confirm the purchase.

A success message confirms: "Credits purchased successfully. They will be added to your account shortly." Purchased credits never expire.

You can click the **Refresh** button at the top of the credits section to see your updated balance after a purchase.

## Auto-reload

Set up automatic credit replenishment so you never run out:

1. Toggle **Auto-Reload** on.
2. Configure two thresholds:
  - **When credits reach** -- the minimum balance that triggers a reload
  - **Refill back up to** -- the target balance after reloading

The refill amount must be at least 100 credits above the trigger threshold.

3. Click **Save** to apply your auto-reload settings.

To disable auto-reload, toggle it off and save.

## Troubleshooting

- **Manage Credits tab not visible** -- you need an active subscription (inbound or outbound) to access credit management. Subscribe first from the Subscription tab.
- **"Validation Error" when saving auto-reload** -- make sure the "Refill back up to" value is at least 100 credits above the "When credits reach" value, and the refill amount is at least 10 credits.
- **Credits not appearing after purchase** -- purchased credits may take a moment to reflect. Click the **Refresh** button to update the display. If they still do not appear after a few minutes, contact support.

- Review text message history
- Check call analytics and usage charts

### Contacts and CRM

- Create and manage support tickets

- Create and edit web forms
- Preview and configure your chatbot

## Rich UI cards

When results benefit from visual display, Business Builder renders interactive cards inline in the chat. Examples include:

- **Confirmation Card** -- approve or reject a proposed change
- **Call Log Player** -- listen to call recordings

## Chat sessions

Business Builder saves your conversation history. You can:

- Continue a previous conversation
- Start a new chat session
- Review past interactions
